scenarios.name: Retain separate zoom levels in two windows of a part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the user creates a second window for the part through View New
the first window displays an active sketch
the user scrolls to zoom in within the second window
the user selects the first window from the View tab's Switch menu
the first window retains its previous sketch view and scale
the user returns to the second window
the second window retains its zoomed-in view
